# durantic_registry_credential (Resource)

Manages a Durantic registry credential — authentication details for a container image registry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Minimal example — only required fields
resource "durantic_registry_credential" "minimal" {
  name         = "my-registry"
  registry_url = "registry.example.com"
  username     = "myuser"
  password     = var.registry_password
}

# Full example with optional fields
resource "durantic_registry_credential" "example" {
  name         = "my-registry"
  registry_url = "registry.example.com"
  username     = "myuser"
  password     = var.registry_password
  description  = "Production container registry credentials"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the registry credential.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Registry password or access token. Sensitive — stored in state but never returned by the API.
- `registry_url` (String) URL of the container registry (e.g. `registry.example.com`).
- `username` (String) Registry username.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the registry credential.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the registry credential was created.
- `image_count` (Number) Number of images associated with this credential.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the registry credential was last updated.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the registry credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import durantic_registry_credential.example <UUID>
```
